source_freeze_corrections: Opening *ርእይዋ confirmed; earlier working *ርእዩ omitted the final fourth-order Waw object suffix. Completion own first freeze had ሚት, inherited drafts ሜት; both complete Charles images show ሜቱ. Closing own freeze provisional ይስተርአ corrects to ያስተርኢ based on initial left-only Yaman IV and terminal Alf III foot; exact lexicon imperfect agrees. This is informed corrective work after the unchanged freeze.
completion_diagnostic: An attached lower-right projection about three-fifths down the stem is visible distinctly from the Ethiopic divider in both Charles views. Same-edition 32:3 ለእልክቱ has the matching extra lower-right projection. Same-edition 7:3 final Taw VI lacks it. The headed order control distinguishes the right attachments; no lexicon normalization to the citation lemma. A vocalic singular suffix is grammatically plausible. Do not name its antecedent as a separately printed referent.
final_attachment_diagnostic: The adjacent work expression is grammatically possible, but not the only possible connection. Earth is marked feminine by the earlier suffix and is less naturally resumed by this singular masculine-looking verb. ለአምላክ belongs to work’s nominal construction, not an overt new subject. No explicit pronoun or object licenses “God shows,” “they appear,” or the unsupported epistemic rewrite “as is apparent.” Use a circumstantial bracket with no named subject. Stronger resolution would require a precise parallel with the same pronoun/constituent sequence, or close manuscript collation clarifying the syntactic dependency; photographed Greek/Aramaic comparison does not solve the selected sequence.
archaic_or_external_controls: OCP edited 4Q201/204 segments u1648–1649 and Greek u1779 read directly from the bound TEI only after freeze; markings and restoration retained in audit, not inserted into candidate.
